claims.verbatim:
Steamship Scotia (Br), Judkins, Liverpool June 2, and
Queenstown 3d, at 8:40 PM, with mdse and passengers, to E
Cunard. 2d inst, off Crosby lightship, passed ship Jeremiah
Thompson, hence, bound in; 3d, off Queenstown, steamship
Iarna[?], bound in; 4th, lat 51 08[?], lon 14 55[?], steamship City of [cut]
New York, hence for Liverpool; 5th, lat 50 48, lon 21 40, a
National Company's steamer, bound E; same day, steam-
ship City of Limerick, hence for Liverpool; 6th, lat 48 44, lon
32 53, a steamer, supposed the Tripoli, hence for Liverpool.
